Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the overview around the controller, immutable revisions, canvas history, and placement presentation; preserve accurate grid, floating-box, and persistence boundaries.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
  |   |   `-- Distinguish immutable content revisions and logical nodeRefs from the presentation of each placement.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace the service-owned edit path with revision submission, retention, and controller publication; keep the separate-commit exec contract.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Describe checkpoints as binding issued revisions, not issuing content revisions themselves.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace the sole-content-writer service model with immutable revision operations, explicit retention, and separate generation orchestration.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) - Projection  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
  |   |   `-- Add per-placement inline swapping, attached SidePanels, and regular or diff display; these change projected rows without rebinding content.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [P2] Review versus presentation - two independent operations
  |       `-- Keep optional revision decisions and their three-way content application distinct from display-only comparison and ChangeSession acceptance.
  |-- Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: DIAGRAM REVISIONS + PRESENTATION CHOICES
  |   |   `-- Place implemented inline controls and SidePanel comparison under presentation, separate from review application.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: 2  PRESENTATION ALTERNATIVES
  |       `-- Add shared diagram diff and row projection as the display path for comparison, not as review decisions.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the obsolete interface inventory to include pinned DiffTree reads, DiffSession and push endpoints, expanded editing, and presentation comparison; retain live bridge and workspace routes.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       `-- Show ChangeSessionService owning capture and proposal operations, the workflow owning generation, and push delivery starting that workflow; keep acceptance separate.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [MODEL] ChangeSession ownership
  |   |   `-- Add repository ownership, pinned commit context, captured hunks, DiffTree, and migrations to the existing proposal model.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the call overview to locate frozen capture, DiffTree navigation, workflow materialization, and migration checks beside direct edits while retaining independent ready and accept paths.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [P] Session persistence and reopening
  |   |   `-- Include persisted DiffTree generations and scoped tree reads alongside document and receipt references.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Baseline/proposed -> unified review
  |   |   `-- Identify diagram diff and row projection as shared display-only comparison, not optional revision-review decisions.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [A] Ready validation and atomic acceptance
  |   |   `-- Add DiffTree, repository-ownership, and migration checks before existing atomic catalog publication.
  |   `-- [2] Add: DiffTree capture and navigation
  |       `-- Detail pinned hunk mappings, scoped reads, and jumps into proposal diagrams; attach from [CALLS] ChangeSession operations at its DiffTree component.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Locate DiffTree records, workflow artifacts, and push generations under their respective stores; keep them distinct from workspace autosave and accepted catalog revisions.
  `-- [3] DiffSession generation and push integration  new canvas
      |-- Workflow overview
      |   `-- Show the two-step shared agent session, frozen ChangeSession capture, proposal-scoped tools, and ready result; connect from Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities at its workflow component.
      |-- Push-to-workflow lifecycle
      |   `-- Show connection validation, event identity, net-change resolution, skip cases, and linked workflow status; push delivery does not accept proposals.
      `-- Pinned evidence and run records
          `-- Show restricted source reads, retained workflow artifacts and metrics, replay, and interruption; connect storage detail to PersistentLayer's workflow and push components.
